subject.title: feat(gateway): deliver plugin approvals to paired iOS devices via APNs

question: Should plugin approval APNs be restricted to capable clients and use generic lock-screen text before the gateway begins sending them?
rationale: This determines both the mixed-version rollout contract and whether plugin-authored approval metadata is permitted to cross the APNs and lock-screen privacy boundary.

options.title: Gate and sanitize before merge
options.body: Add an advertised client capability, retain generic notification copy, coordinate the iOS handler, and require real-device proof before enabling delivery.

options.title: Pause the server half
options.body: Keep plugin APNs disabled until the companion iOS implementation and a reviewed rollout contract are ready together.

recommendation.title: Gate and sanitize before merge
recommendation.body: Add an advertised client capability, retain generic notification copy, coordinate the iOS handler, and require real-device proof before enabling delivery.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature was scoped as part of the related approval work and this proposal coordinates its server and iOS rollout.
